title: Maximum weakly stable matchings in graphs without odd preference cycles

statement.text: Let ''(G,<)'' be a [[Stable matching#preference system|preference system with ties]] where in every odd cycle there is a node that prefers its clockwise neighbour to its other neighbour, and there is another node that prefers its anti-clockwise neighbour to its other neighbour. How well can we approximate the maximum size [[Stable matching#Stable matching|weakly stable matching]]?
